action_args.quote_content: Regulatory Clarification: Under Article 14 of Law No. 13.709/2018 (LGPD), processing of children's and adolescents' personal data—including voice telemetry, handwriting digitization, and multimodal inputs—must strictly prioritize the best interests of the minor. EdTech solutions bridging physical and digital environments must ensure verifiable, specific parental consent and privacy-by-design frameworks prior to any data ingestion within Brazilian jurisdiction.
